name: Agency
pullQuote: Retail is the one business where a customer sees the whole company at once.
overview: The agency business covers retail representation, with watches and jewellery at its centre. These are categories bought rarely and kept a long time, often marking something, which makes the transaction unlike most retail — the customer is not comparing options so much as deciding whether to trust the person in front of them.

Representing a maker means carrying their standard in a room they will never visit. The group treats that as the substance of the work rather than a condition attached to it, because a name is only as intact as its least attentive counter.

approach.heading: The counter is the company
body: Everything the group believes about the long term has to survive a five-minute interaction at a counter. Staff are given the time and the product knowledge to let a customer decide slowly, including the decision not to buy, because a rushed sale in these categories tends to come back.

Aftercare is treated as part of the sale rather than a service that follows it. Objects of this kind are brought back for adjustment, repair and resetting over decades, and those returns are the relationship rather than an interruption to it.
